body.x: TROUND Inc., (CEO JB Park), participated in the 'Startup Zone' at the Eureka Park K-STARTUP integrated hall of 'CES 2023' in Las Vegas, USA from January 5 (Thursday) to 8 (Sunday, local time) for a total of 4 days.

TROUND, founded in 2021, is a company that is currently conducting research and development and business related to the launch and sale of the 'Sound Chair' in January of next year. Their Sound Chair aims to provide users with immersion in media content such as games by installing acoustic and vibration motors on back rests and seats.

The Sound Chair is designed and manufactured to support 5.1-channel sound and allow users to enjoy multi-channel sound sources from global OTT content such as compatible games, movies, and Netflix. High-spec monitor speakers, 5 in total, are placed at the center and front and back left and right of the product to output powerful sound within a distance of just 30cm (11.8in) to confirm the accurate reproduction of sound.

Based on these features, the company explains that the Sound Chair allows users to enjoy the pleasure of listening without the need for separate space or equipment, as if they were at the scene in a theater or video and can feel the same realism as if they were actually there.

JB Park, CEO of TROUND, said, 'The Sound Chair is a product that realizes what is known as a 'sound shower,' which allows users to experience the rich sound emanating from five directions throughout their body,' and added, 'It will offer a feeling that can't be experienced anywhere else, such as the powerful shaking of the jet engine when a fighter plane takes off in the movie 'Top Gun 2' or the impact of the gun I shoot in 'Battle Ground.

TROUND has announced that it plans to open up a new market in the global gaming gear and audio equipment market by applying for 30 domestic and international patents for the Sound Chair. The CEO, JB Park, added, 'We plan to start sales in January in Korea, and at the G-STAR 2022 exhibition held earlier, before the official launch, we received a lot of interest from buyers in India and Vietnam.' Based on this, we expect to achieve significant results in the global market”.

‘CES’ is the world’s biggest IT trade show and is a place where one can see the direction and trends of the appliance industry of the entire world. Hosted by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), it is held annually in Las Vegas, USA in January. Having reported on CES for 17 consecutive years, AVING News started reporting news of CES to the entire world since 2006, and conducted ‘BEST OF CES’, which chose the most innovative product and technology, and ‘BEST OF MADE IN KOREA, which chose the best innovative company in Korea. In addition, it vividly relayed on-site issues in CES through ‘AVING LIVE’.

The K-STARTUP Joint Pavilion featured joint participation of institutions like the Korea Institute of Startup & Entrepreneurship Development, Seoul Business Agency, and Seoul Digital Foundation, as well as 51 Korean innovative companies, to enter the US market and discover global partners. In addition, university student supporters of CES 2023 chosen by each university (Kyunghee, Kookmin, Sogang, Chung-Ang) matched to participating companies based on their respective majors and fields of business.
